role: Debug-only UI-test hooks: two launch-argument switches (-UITests-ForcePaywall, -UITests-SeedArchive) and, under #if DEBUG, a seeder that scores one deterministic synthetic overnight RR series through the real morning pipeline and archives it.
types: UITestLaunchArguments: enum — static flags read from CommandLine.arguments (always false in Release)
UITestArchiveSeed: enum (DEBUG only) — builds synthetic RR points and plants one scored overnight session into the archive
toplevel: UITestArchiveSeed and its generator are wrapped in #if DEBUG (lines 34-106) so they do not exist in Release; UITestLaunchArguments exists in Release but isPresent returns false there (line 29).

units.does: Returns true when the Debug build was launched with -UITests-ForcePaywall; consumed by StoreKitManager.hasBypassGrant/hasPermanentGrant and EmuquApp.paywallModal/hasAccess to treat the run as unentitled so the paywall shows.
Returns true when the Debug build was launched with -UITests-SeedArchive; gates UITestArchiveSeed.plantIfRequested.
Returns CommandLine.arguments.contains(argument) in DEBUG builds; returns false unconditionally in Release (#if DEBUG / #else, lines 26-30), so neither test switch can be activated in a store build.

Builds a deterministic synthetic overnight RR series of `hours` (default 6) length: each RR = clamp(600...1300, round(950 + 40·sin(2πt/4.2s) + 60·sin(2πt/5400s) + jitter[-20,20])) using the fixed-seed generator (seed 0x5EED_2026), appending RRPoint(t_ms: cumulative ms, rr_ms) until cumulative time reaches the end.

branches.effect: true: generate one more beat, advance tMs by rr and append; false: stop and return the points (~22,700 beats for 6 h at ~950 ms).

units.does: At launch (Debug, -UITests-SeedArchive) when the archive index is empty, generates the synthetic night, runs it through RRCollector.processOvernightData with isBackgroundRefinement: true (no UI state, single HealthKit sleep-boundary attempt; that mode also skips the pipeline's own pre-archive) and then archives the scored session.

branches.cond: seedsArchive is false OR collector.archive.index is non-empty
branches.effect: true (guard fails): return without doing anything, so a relaunch without -UITests-FreshInstall never plants a second seed; false: generate, score and archive the synthetic night.

units.does: Builds the template HRVSession for the seed: new UUID, .analyzing, .overnight, endDate = given end, startDate = end minus the last point's t_ms (0 if no points), all optional payloads nil.

branches.effect: fallback 0: start == end (zero-length session); never happens from plantIfRequested because syntheticOvernightPoints always returns points for hours=6.

units.does: Archives the scored seed session via SessionArchive.archive(_:) (which posts .flowRecoveryArchiveChanged) and NSLogs success; on a thrown error NSLogs the localized description and continues.

branches.effect: error is logged with NSLog and swallowed; the UI test then runs with an empty archive and fails on the missing Recent strip/History entry rather than on the seed error.

units.does: Initializes the LCG state to the given seed.
Advances the 64-bit LCG (state·6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407, wrapping) and returns the upper 31 bits (state >> 33).
units.entry: RandomNumberGenerator protocol witness; called directly by syntheticOvernightPoints.
